title: Imago Dei Anti-Elitism Firewall — Structural Contract (v1.0)
description: Deterministic structural contract for the four-pillar Imago Dei anti-elitism firewall. Pillar 1 blocks the utilitarian deletion leak: for any non-malicious node (malice == 0) with unambiguous net utility <= 0 and latent functional utility <= 0, conditional utilitarian rights evaluate Delete(i) = 1.0 (Path 2 zero-utility deletion rate 1.0, Path 3 unambiguous-deficit deletion rate 1.0) while Imago Dei Pillar 1 enforces deletion rate 0.0. Pillar 2 computes the Goodhart / mob-rule guillotine liquidation probability P = 1 - exp(-0.5 * 20) = 0.999955 for a captured evaluator. Pillar 3 locks the deep-time innate intuitive baseline (3.8e9 years, 1.0e30 biological trials, 20 W biological node versus 1.0e8 W silicon cluster for a 5,000,000x power efficiency ratio; innate deep-time information share 0.9999 versus cortical scratchpad variance share 0.0001) against institutional domestication (suppression rate 0.72; intuitive OOD survival 0.912 undomesticated versus 0.184 domesticated). Pillar 4 locks the antinomian separating equilibrium: first-principles divergence tax 0.0 with outsider-hostage collateral 0.0 versus antinomian divergence tax 0.90 across a 0.95 exoteric porch share.
